name: Amazing Gold Detecting in Australia
description: AMAZING COMPETITION, 14 DAYS GOLD DETECTING IN AUSTRALIA in aid of combat stress! You could win two weeks gold detecting in the Australian gold fields in October 2027. This is going to a trip of a lifetime so get ready to dig deep for a great cause. Every single ticket helps us raise funds for veterans so please click the link to join. Can't wait to see who will be heading out for this epic adventure...UK entries only
